content:
pager-bot: ALERT: decode-serving cluster gpu-decode-prod-1 reporting elevated CUDA_OOMs (cuMemAlloc failures) and streaming request drops across p0 routes. 50% error rate on /v1/stream with spike at 4301234500

alex: seeing a bunch of container restarts on node gnode-37, kernel logs show CUDA OOM then watchdog kill. Stack: \u003cpre\u003eE/CUDA: cuMemAlloc failed: out of memory
terminate called after throwing an instance of 'std::bad_alloc'
\u003c/pre\u003e

gina: high-priority. estimate customer-facing drops ~1500 req/min, mainly chat streaming. Any recent deploy?

maria: rolled model-route change 20m ago (bigger context window for open-llm-v2). Could be memory blowup due to longer KV cache.

chris: yes that rollout increased default max_context to 8192 for that route. Traffic pattern shows heavy tail, some users sending very large prompts + no client-side max_tokens.

alex: immediate mitigations I propose: 1) disable streaming for the affected route (proxy-level) 2) enforce conservative max_tokens header at edge 3) take overloaded gnode-37 out of rotation. Thoughts?

gina: +1 to taking node OOB. We should also enable outbound fallback to CPU-decoder pool for non-low-latency tier to avoid drops.

sre-bot: ACTION CREATED: incident/4301234567 -> Pager assigned to alex. Priority P1. Runbook: decode/gpu-oom -> link to playbook.

alex: running: kubectl cordon gnode-37 && kubectl drain gnode-37 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data; patching service to reduce max inflight to 50

maria: i'll rollback the model route change to previous variant (open-llm-v1) for the /v1/stream traffic. Preparing canary patch now.

chris: also adding a short-term proxy override: set X-Redwood-Max-Tokens: 1024 for that route. nginx patch ready.

gina: please post exact commands and I'll execute oncall handoff after.

alex: commands: 

kubectl label node gnode-37 quarantine=true
kubectl patch deployment decode-service -p '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"decode","env":[{"name":"MAX_IN_FLIGHT","value":"50"},{"name":"MAX_TOKENS_OVERRIDE","value":"1024"}]}]}}}}'

proxy patch (nginx): 

location /v1/stream {
  proxy_set_header X-Redwood-Max-Tokens 1024;
  proxy_set_header X-Redwood-Disable-Streaming yes;
}

alex: applied node cordon+drain; decode pods rescheduled away from gnode-37. Starting deployment patch for MAX_TOKENS_OVERRIDE.

maria: rolled model back and scaled down v2 variant to 0 replicas. Observability: latency dropping and OOM errors decreasing.

sre-bot: NOTE: automatic fallback configured: route=non-prod-cpu enabled for tier=standard, will shift ~30% of new requests to CPU pool.

gina: telemetry shows errors drop from 50% -> 6% after patches. Client drops reduced but a subset of in-flight streaming requests still dropped during the hot window. Need customer outreach.

chris: compiling brief for CS: timeline, affected routes, estimate affected customers ~12 (high usage), recommended postmortem actions.

alex: oncall handoff: @oncall-lead will take over in 25 minutes. Current blockers: 1) verify no remaining corrupted KV caches 2) run full node memory soak tests 3) patch to hard-enforce max_tokens at edge in proxy and SDK.

oncall-lead: taking handoff now. Summary received. Repro steps and follow-ups?

alex: to repro: send a long prompt + unset max_tokens -> observe decode pod memory growth and cuMemAlloc failure within ~60s. I can share script snippet.

alex: repro script: 

curl -N -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' 
  -d '{"model":"open-llm-v2","prompt":"'$(python -c 'print("x"*50000)')'","stream":true}' 
  https://api.redwood.example/v1/stream

maria: saved heap profiles from the hot pods: gprof and nvprof traces attached to incident ticket. Looks KV cache not evicted as expected when sequence length exceeds threshold.

gina: ok action items for post-incident: 1) instrument KV cache eviction thresholds 2) add a service-level hard guard for X-Redwood-Max-Tokens in gateway 3) add a model-route rollout checklist (validate mem usage against synthetic tails) 4) improve customer-facing communications template.

chris: i'm drafting customer note; will ask support to prepare targeted messages for the 12 customers. Include recommended mitigations (client-level max_tokens, SDK update with default cap).

sre-bot: REMINDER: document nodes quarantined: gnode-37, gnode-42 (some earlier soft OOM signs). Add to maintenance pool.

oncall-lead: I've validated pods stable after cordon and proxy changes, error rate steady at ~2-4% (expected background). Moving incident to monitoring state. Will keep watch for 2 hours then close if stable.

alex: leaving detailed notes in the incident ticket and handover checklist. Thanks team. :thumbsup:

maria: follow-up postmortem owner: maria. Planned delivery: 72h. Will include memory profiles and recommended runtime safeguards.

chris: +1. Also add a test in CI that simulates long-sequence KV growth against canary models during rollouts.

gina: closing loop on oncall: please escalate if error rate re-spikes.

sre-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: status -> monitoring. Owners: maria (postmortem), chris (customer comms).

alex: signing off from active oncall for this incident.
